results.title: Nvidia Turmoil: How Big Is the Risk for CoreWeave?
results.author: Adria Cimino
results.description: CoreWeave, a neocloud company offering access to Nvidia's AI chips, faces potential risks from Nvidia's recent turmoil including CEO Jensen Huang's brief departure and SEC accounting probe. Investors remain concerned about the sustainability of AI infrastructure spending and potential policy shifts under Democratic leadership.
